title: Portable Blue-and-green Striped Backpack Beach ChairFoldable And Adjustable Reclining Beach Lounger Suitable For Outdoor Beach And Camping Use.Self-pickup Only.
body_html:
Our Blue Green Striped Portable Backpack Beach Chair is a versatile outdoor essential crafted for seaside vacations, camping trips, lawn relaxation and poolside lounging.Designed with refreshing blue-green gradient striped fabric, it delivers a stylish coastal look while ensuring outstanding practicality for all outdoor scenarios.The chair is made of thickened high-density oxford fabric, which is tear-resistant, quick-drying and easy to brush off sand or seawater stains, holding up well under intense sunlight and humid beach conditions.

Supported by lightweight yet sturdy rust-proof metal frame, this folding beach chair features a space-saving collapsible design that folds flat for effortless transport and compact storage.Equipped with adjustable shoulder straps, you can carry it like a backpack when heading to the beach or hiking outdoors, freeing your hands for towels, snacks and personal items.The backrest supports multiple reclining positions, allowing you to sit upright for reading or lean back fully to sunbathe and take a comfortable nap.A convenient side storage pouch is attached to hold your smartphone, sunglasses, sunscreen lotion and small accessories within easy reach.

With padded armrest details and stable anti-slip foot caps to avoid slipping on sand and grass, this ergonomic recliner balances durability and comfort perfectly. Ideal for family beach outings, weekend camping and backyard leisure, it is a must-have outdoor furniture piece for travel and outdoor enthusiasts.
